description: CAPTURE-SPEC C2: UnityEngine.Random (native, UnityPlayer.dll) sequences after Random.InitState(seed), with the raw xorshift128 state (Random.State s0..s3 via reflection), plus KSP consumers that seed it (DiscoveryInfo.GetClassRadius, the ScenarioDiscoverableObjects.SpawnHomeAsteroid random sequence) and KSPRandom.

provenance.decimal_format: normalized from _hex by harness/captures/tools/normalize.py (harness ExactNumber.FormatFloat/FormatDouble on .NET Framework ToString G6..G9 / G15..G17)

tables.name: states
tables.description: Random.state (s0..s3 as signed int32) after each block. Blocks: init = right after InitState(seed); after_value = 64 x value; after_range_f = InitState + 64 x Range(-10f,10f); after_range_i = InitState + 64 x Range(0,7) + 64 x Range(-1000,1000); after_vec = InitState + 16 x insideUnitSphere, onUnitSphere, rotation, insideUnitCircle; after_edge = InitState + the edge table calls.

tables.name: range_i
tables.description: After InitState(seed): 64 x Random.Range(0,7) then 64 x Random.Range(-1000,1000) (one stream).

tables.name: vec
tables.description: After InitState(seed): 16 x insideUnitSphere, 16 x onUnitSphere, 16 x rotation, 16 x insideUnitCircle (one stream, in that order).

tables.name: edge
tables.description: After InitState(seed), one stream of edge-case calls in k order; ri = int result, f0..f3 = float results.

tables.name: trace
tables.description: After InitState(seed): state before each of 12 Random.value calls and the value returned (pins the xorshift128 step and the uint->float mapping).

tables.name: trace_int
tables.description: After InitState(seed): state before each of 12 Random.Range(int.MinValue, int.MaxValue) calls and the result.

tables.name: trace_vec
tables.description: After InitState(seed): 16 calls of each vector function (fresh InitState per function), with the state before (s0..s3) and after (a0..a3) every call, so draws per call and the formulas can be fitted.

tables.name: ksp_class_radius
tables.description: DiscoveryInfo.GetClassRadius(class, seed): InitState(seed) then base radius * Random.Range(0.75f, 1.25f) (DiscoveryInfo.cs:362-399).

tables.name: ksp_random
tables.description: KSPRandom(seed) (KSPRandom.cs, a copy of the .NET Random algorithm): separate instances for NextDouble() and Next().

tables.name: ksp_asteroid
tables.description: ScenarioDiscoverableObjects.SpawnHomeAsteroid random sequence (ScenarioDiscoverableObjects.cs:250-290) without spawning a vessel: InitState(seed); GetRandomDuration(); GenerateAsteroidName(); GetSizeCurveBasedClass(0,1); Random.Range(minUntrackedLifetime,maxUntrackedLifetime)*86400; Orbit.CreateRandomOrbitFlyBy(home, duration). Component created inactive with OnAwake() called by hand (default sizeCurve).
